title: Paloma and the Room
author: W. M. Zhou
blurb: Orsen Nakamura, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
